purpose: The eight ways a model-written case fails, each with the stage where it starts, the mitigation built into the prompts, and the deterministic checks that catch it. Written by the kit author; the research document's Track 6 was not available.

modes.name: Stock prose and signposting
modes.symptom: Familiar phrases, adjectives doing the work of particulars, feelings named instead of shown.
modes.mitigation: Prompts demand measured, dated, named particulars and silence after them; the ban lists are injected into every prose stage.

modes.name: Semantic leakage
modes.symptom: Titles, subjects, findings or mail that conclude, summarise or hint beyond the facts assigned.
modes.mitigation: One document at a time, with only its assigned facts; claims list per text; findings kept apart from assessment.

modes.name: Telegraphed solution
modes.symptom: A single document or confession gives an answer; the turn is stated rather than assembled.
modes.mitigation: Every correct option needs facts from at least two documents; the aha conclusion is never written down; confession phrases are banned.

modes.name: Unearned turn
modes.symptom: The reframing relies on information introduced late, or the herring is never cleanly refuted.
modes.mitigation: Mask before reframe by tier; herring induced early and refuted by later paper; patterns brief their own pre-signalling.

modes.name: Voice collapse
modes.symptom: Every author sounds like the same careful narrator.
modes.mitigation: Department profiles on four axes with measurable markers; person sheets carry voice notes; overlap check across documents.

modes.name: Constraint drift
modes.symptom: Names, times, codes or numbers change between documents.
modes.mitigation: Python picks names and critical strings and injects them verbatim; preservation and near-miss name checks.

modes.name: Cardboard cast and wallpaper world
modes.symptom: People exist only as suspects; quirks stand in for character; world documents are decoration.
modes.mitigation: Person sheets and their tests; page presence rules; every document has an author, a reader and an in-world reason; world records fused with a person.

modes.name: Overreach
modes.symptom: Too many suspects, places, codes or threads for one sitting.
modes.mitigation: Cognitive budget is data and is checked before any clue exists.
